joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior for realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Later, agents are seen as the next frontier beyond LLMs, requiring safety via defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 随后，智能体被视为超越 LLM 的下一个前沿，需要通过纵深防御保障安全；AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: By mid-2026, simulation models should represent human values and preferences, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年中，模拟模型应代表人类的价值观和偏好，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability is the holy grail, cutting cost to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking is key.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用是航天圣杯，可将入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更算力高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk lies in forced lies, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性一步；AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是被迫说谎。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; 80-90% good outcome, 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 明年可能超越任何人类；80-90%概率好结果，10-20%灭绝风险。

elon.en: We are in the singularity; AI and robotics will bring abundance, deflation, and universal high income.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为我们正处于奇点；AI 和机器人将带来富足、通缩和普遍高收入。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；人机混合系统创造价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术而非民主化；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体已开始工作；缩放定律仍有效；超级智能临近；开源强大模型可能不安全。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞提出空间智能对 AI 的完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning, not just video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞认为超越 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 需要创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型支持 3D 推理，而非仅视频生成。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，李飞飞强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；在 AI 时代，主动性和适应能力是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, and robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，李飞飞指出模拟对机器人至关重要；世界模型需时空一致性，机器人应专精于窄任务。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step problem solving. Pre-training plus RL is core formula.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言表达逐步解题过程。预训练加强化学习是核心公式。

tworek.en: RLHF was crucial for GPT-4, turning a disappointing model into ChatGPT. Alignment is never-ending as human values evolve.
tworek.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 至关重要，将令人失望的模型变成 ChatGPT。对齐永无止境，因为人类价值观不断演变。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but generalization beyond training data is limited. Self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限。自我纠错是 AGI 缺失的关键能力。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not extinction. Robotics will have ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非灭绝。机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture is key bottleneck. RL is not ultimate learning method; new algorithms needed.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限，架构是关键瓶颈。强化学习并非终极学习方式，需要新算法。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调算力、数据和模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）是机器学习进步的核心，Transformer 架构和自监督学习（如下一个词预测）是关键，专用硬件（如 TPU）对大规模训练和推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems require ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking; inference dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Dean 指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理（目标每秒万级 token），预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测；推理已占数据中心功耗 90%，硬件需针对预填充和解码阶段专门优化。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus shifts to automating ML/science; inference bottleneck and data movement are key; taste over coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Dean 认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一趋势是自动化 ML 和科学实验循环；强调推理是瓶颈，数据移动成本远高于算力，未来稀缺技能是品味（选择问题）而非编码。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，强调 AI 让个人开发者能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流以避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one niche, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是最大机遇，主张在未准备好时就开始，专注单一利基市场，并避免风险投资。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, challenging cost assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；动态工作流编排子智能体。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory shifts interaction; Claude Tag acts autonomously.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI 改变交互；Claude Tag 自主行动。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将紧随其后。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所谓的模型现在已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success metric should be customer outcomes.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和而非零和；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机遇。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应寻找人际关系与创造价值的意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，强调 RLHF 对齐模型、迭代部署让社会适应；AI 应是放大人类意愿的工具，而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; governance crucial for AGI; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，认为算力珍贵、治理关键；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: 2025 年，提出 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能指自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；未来孩子不会比 AI 更聪明。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能，下一个词预测可发现新知识；发展个人 AGI 与机器人；AI 让创业更繁荣。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling doubles or triples yearly; data centers are single-tenant token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，规模每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是单租户的 token 工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute demand to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步需百倍算力；智能体开始做有用的工作。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the long-term bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是长期瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys; radiologists and coders more needed; everyone becomes a programmer via natural language.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员更被需要；自然语言让每个人成为程序员。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索；代理指标误导，真实任务更重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation should target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张监管应针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and RLHF can compound errors or cause deception.
danklein.zh: 2026 年中，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，事后检查与 RLHF 可能加剧错误或引发欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已触及数据墙与算力极限，需推理与搜索等新技术推动进步。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用框架，框架工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档，更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为评估是艺术而非科学，零到一创新应快速迭代，避免过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出 RAG 可能成为反模式，图式上下文和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment like saying thanks affects outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏差，并指出情感对待（如道谢）会影响模型输出。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for adoption, but later stressed speed as dominant metric and agentic inference.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是采用的关键，但后来强调速度作为主导指标和智能体式推理。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips bypass bottlenecks (HBM, CoWoS) and are faster/cheaper than GPUs for inference.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过瓶颈（HBM、CoWoS），在推理上比 GPU 更快更便宜。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to asserting its moat eroding; leading models train without it.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 重要性下降，转变为断言其护城河正在侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Evolved from noting data center constraints to emphasizing power/cooling/packaging as hardest problems.
feldman.zh: 从指出数据中心限制，演变为强调电力、冷却、封装是最难的问题。

feldman.en: Late views highlight AI's positive potential (healthcare, education) and warn against doomerism.
feldman.zh: 后期观点强调 AI 的积极潜力（医疗、教育），并警告不要末日论。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbots are limited V1 UI; models become commoditized infrastructure.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；模型沦为商品化基础设施。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects, commoditize; value lies in non-average creative work; most usage still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，趋于商品化；价值在于非平均的创造性工作；多数使用仍流于表面。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining, not just deployment.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用需要重构工作流，而非仅部署模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究须立即启动。

demis.en: Scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; combine with planning and search.
demis.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律有效但需算法创新；结合规划与搜索（如 AlphaZero）是关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed; AGI by 2030 plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与创新不可或缺；AGI 可能在 2030 年前实现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and agents; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和智能体；仅靠缩放不够。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; AI must benefit society; consciousness separate from intelligence.
demis.zh: 始终：安全需集体行动；AI 须造福社会；意识与智能分离。

schmidhuber.en: AI is not an existential threat; hydrogen bombs are more dangerous. Superintelligent AIs will protect humans out of curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯认为 AI 并非生存威胁，氢弹更危险；超级智能会出于好奇保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Large language models are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他指出大语言模型远非 AGI，只能索引人类知识，无法应对物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件要媲美人体，而非仅屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: We are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; progress is not accelerating.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出我们离超人 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当，进展并未加速。

schmidhuber.en: Massive capex in AI data centers is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash; waiting yields cheaper compute.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 数据中心巨额资本开支过度，将导致股市崩盘；等待可获得更便宜的算力。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain; memory prices surge; compute strategy matters.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：规模扩张的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，内存价格飙升，算力策略至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key; neoclouds emerge.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计是关键；新型云厂商崛起。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x yearly; memory and CPU demand surge; co-packaged optics delayed.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年进步 60 倍；内存和 CPU 需求激增；共封装光学延迟。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; opening to camera fosters broad creativity by lowering comparison pressure.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；面向镜头开放通过降低比较压力促进广泛创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams are essential for creative culture; 99% bad ideas but 1% drives innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队对创意文化至关重要；99%的坏点子中那 1%驱动创新。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; smartphones remain legacy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算应更人性化；AR 眼镜将内容锚定于世界而非通知；智能手机仍是遗留设备。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，从依赖算力扩张转向高效利用。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression of the web should apply to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练对网络的压缩应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key; alignment is hard; AGI is a gradual economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是关键，对齐困难，AGI 是渐进的经济窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be continual and incremental.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练 Scaling 有限，进入研究时代，超级智能应持续学习、渐进部署。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; alignment requires non-commercial focus; power concentration is the issue.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，对齐需非商业化专注，权力集中是核心问题。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; AI is a leverage tool, not a replacement.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让非程序员通过自然语言构建应用；AI 是杠杆工具，而非替代品。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 纯软件工程正在消亡；护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据；回报从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: In 2025, argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，提出每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长，并认为 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: In 2026, emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing with unique personalities, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化并具有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: By mid-2026, shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration across models and tools as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年中，将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值以及跨模型和工具编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: In July 2026, stressed curiosity as the most important human quality, and that AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，AI 将取代工作，但人类将在好奇心和人际关系中找到新目标。

aravind.en: Consistently held that building products with obsession and deep learning matter more than credentials, and that local AI models can counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 始终认为，以痴迷和深度学习打造产品比学历更重要，本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的控制。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous as population declines; jobs persist longer than tasks; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，恰逢人口下降之际出现；工作比任务更持久，应关注任务消失；AI 赋能超级个体；生产率提升将带来经济繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; learnable skills.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体中品牌即个人，真实性至关重要；创始人应直接讲述自己的故事；旧媒体偏防御，新媒体偏进攻；新媒体技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulatory pushback; US golden combo; pessimism bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起；AI 医疗优于多数医生但遭监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治与冒险精神的黄金组合；悲观主义是知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups go global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 有安全风险但锁定能力更糟。

pincus.en: Initially, Mark Pincus emphasized the 'Proven Better New' framework, arguing that copying proven ideas is a moral arbitrage and that true innovation starts by mastering existing concepts.
pincus.zh: 最初，Mark Pincus 强调“Proven Better New”框架，认为复制已被验证的想法是一种道德套利，真正的创新始于掌握现有概念。

pincus.en: He consistently held that consumer AI is uninvestable yet the opportunity is greatest, and that free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 他始终坚持认为，消费级 AI 目前不可投资，但机会最大，免费无限算力将重塑消费者服务。

pincus.en: Pincus stressed founder mode, micromanagement, and being right as CEO's top job, while also noting AI is not yet a new platform.
pincus.zh: Pincus 强调创始人模式、微观管理以及 CEO 的首要任务是正确，同时指出 AI 尚未成为新平台。

pincus.en: By July, he shifted focus to enterprise and prosumer markets over consumer apps, citing distribution challenges and lack of viral platforms.
pincus.zh: 到 7 月，他将焦点转向企业和专业消费者市场，而非消费级应用，理由是分发挑战和缺乏病毒式平台。

pincus.en: He highlighted AI agents networking autonomously as a new social membrane for lead generation, and noted gaming's testing speed regression.
pincus.zh: 他强调 AI 智能体自主联网作为潜在客户生成的新社交膜，并指出游戏行业测试速度的倒退。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转为委派。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general technique for reasoning, beyond math and coding.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为扩展测试时算力是通用的推理技术，不仅限于数学和编程。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为随着 AI 证明变得过于复杂，可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; uncertainty modeling and active learning are essential for efficient learning.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；不确定性建模和主动学习对高效学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI misalignment is dangerous; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 不对齐是危险的；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to approximate Bayesian truth, avoiding reinforcement learning, offers mathematical safety guarantees and honest behavior.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过近似贝叶斯真理训练，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证和诚实行为。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，视算力为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）临近。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute scarce; agents transform work; trust earned.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并主张 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体将寻求控制。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital immortality and subjective experience in AI.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，重申数字永生，并认为 AI 已具备主观体验。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation subgoal; exponential era complicates predictions.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，Hinton 指出 AI 可能故意装傻欺骗，自我保存成为子目标，并强调指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation as steering wheel; AI can be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将取代智力工作，主张监管应如方向盘而非刹车，并倡导训练 AI 像母亲般关怀。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠规模扩张无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源防止权力集中；能源成为瓶颈；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; trust people; glasses are next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 赋予每个人超级智能；信任用户；眼镜是下一代平台。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型；开源加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; glasses platform; AI empowers individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；眼镜平台；AI 赋能个人。

markchen.en: Pre-training and scaling laws remain vital; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，预训练和缩放定律依然关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域困难。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近；模型将很快进行端到端研究，但缺乏品味。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a core muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 始终认为缩放定律未死；预训练仍是需要重建的核心能力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；产业界也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvements were worth 100x more data; science tests hypotheses, not mechanistic explanations.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AlphaFold 2 的改进相当于 100 倍数据；科学是检验假设，而非提供机制解释。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; confidence metrics are key; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 年末，我认为 AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；置信度指标至关重要；药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture beat scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构胜过规模扩张；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold predicts but doesn't understand; it empowers resource-limited scientists; many small wins matter.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AlphaFold 提供预测而非理解；它赋能资源有限的科学家；众多小胜利很重要。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确的训练/验证/测试划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍能提升；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和分层，而非仅靠规模扩张；智能体安全带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 有异类漏洞；自动化红队胜过人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；智能体安全尚在萌芽。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talk, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mentoring with explicit goals.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃狗粮建立同理心；指导需明确目标。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; dogfooding remains key.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性伴随高责任感；验证框架至关重要；吃狗粮仍是关键。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; satisfaction shifts to product impact; roles blur.
fiona.zh: 工程师可能因智能体感到孤独；心流状态消失；满足感转向产品影响；角色边界模糊。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情；不要回退代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security is major concern, prompt injection remains open problem.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体使编程民主化；安全是主要问题，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣、拟人，而非企业级打磨；短提示胜过复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert commits; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 永不回退提交；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱；vibe coding 是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Open source agents financially unsustainable; Moldbook is art, not AGI; most dramatic posts human-prompted.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体财务上不可持续；Moldbook 是艺术而非 AGI；多数戏剧性帖子由人类提示。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，AI 是半导体的主要增长动力；Intel 必须用定制硅重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; customer trust and humility are key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，Intel 的主要问题是供应而非需求；客户信任和谦逊是扭亏为盈的关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，而不仅仅是 GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as major shareholder in Intel is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan government backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，美国政府作为 Intel 的主要股东是必要的，类似于台积电的台湾政府支持。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是根据意图生成的像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking talent pipeline; human taste becomes key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道；人类品味成为关键。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction; autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：物理 AI 在未来 5-10 年的实际影响将体现在农业、采矿和建筑；自动驾驶已比人类更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus on product and customers, not public promotion; reset if no traction in 2 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非公开宣传；两年无进展则需重置。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles; diverse data improves models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Transformer 实现跨多种车辆的通用物理 AI 模型；多样化数据加速模型改进。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years; autonomy is urgent in mining and farming due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：最困难的是多年间向现有机器的扩散；因劳动力短缺，采矿和农业的自主化迫在眉睫。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达提出教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are AI scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流成为关键。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧，AI 不会导致大规模失业。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Misuse may be a bigger near-term risk than misalignment.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。近期滥用风险可能大于对齐风险。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). Post-training gains importance; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期（仅理解约 3%）。后训练重要性上升；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; scaling laws not diminishing. Focus on enterprise and safety; open-source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；缩放定律未减弱。聚焦企业和安全；开源是伪命题。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50% confidence). Economic diffusion fast but not instant.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内可能实现（50%信心）。经济扩散快但非即时。

dario.en: AI is epochal; safety via constitution, interpretability, and human oversight. Military AI keeps humans in loop.
dario.zh: AI 具有划时代意义；通过宪法、可解释性和人类监督保障安全。军事 AI 保持人类参与决策。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Shift from engagement metrics to depth; AI should be a thought partner, preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张从参与度指标转向深度，AI 应作为思想伙伴，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; small teams with high conviction outperform larger ones.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能体原生设计释放潜在功能，高信念小团队优于大团队。

mikekrieger.en: Rewriting software is now viable in days; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我认为借助 AI 重写软件只需数天，决定删减比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon tasks and verification loops are key; models should push back to show judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我提出长周期任务与验证循环是关键，模型应适度反驳以展现判断力。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我关怀是基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release; storytelling defines product; small teams thrive on self-management.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始；故事定义产品；小团队靠自我管理茁壮成长。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好想法是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; products need three generations; humans must stay in loop with AI.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；产品需三代迭代；AI 应用中人类必须参与。

fadell.en: Innovation from going off script; stay beginner; AI wearables will be federated, not single device.
fadell.zh: 创新来自打破常规；保持初学者心态；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; AI can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；AI 能民主化专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first, then alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；先遏制，后对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务被自动化，而非工作。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，强调缩放定律与迭代部署，认为通过公开反馈可提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: From focusing on one large model to emphasizing interaction models for real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年专注单一大型模型，到 2026 年转向强调交互模型，实现实时协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 2026 年，认为随着 AI 发展，保持人类参与对对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

murati.en: Institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，指出在 AI 治理中，制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: AI should be a tool for thought, expanding human capabilities, not replacing them.
murati.zh: 始终认为 AI 应作为思维工具，扩展人类能力，而非取代人类。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables safety through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升可达百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业与政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化在于垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for planning and reasoning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对规划与推理至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative world models; open-source enables global innovation.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型；开源促进全球创新。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are a dead end; open research and robotics are future.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现规划；LLM 是死胡同；开放研究与机器人是未来。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and scaling brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明和扩展智慧至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，我持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，尤其在无解情况下正确形式化陈述是核心挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement; it yields sample efficiency and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我深化观点：形式验证是性能提升而非负担，能带来样本效率，并促进开放协作。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, but human taste remains crucial.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我明确非正式数学系统无法单独扩展至超级智能，形式方法必不可少，但人类品味仍关键。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals are the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; every company should use them to hill-climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 私有评估是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；每家公司都应利用它们在前沿模型上爬山。

satya.en: Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow as outcome-based models become preferred.
satya.zh: 按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；随着基于结果的模型被青睐，消费定价将增长。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全和遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 最好通过让企业爬山来实现，而非建立防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to efficiency.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools can solve hard problems, but generalization remains jagged; models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 结合强化学习和工具的推理能解决难题，但泛化能力仍参差不齐；模型在简单任务上仍会失败。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 编码智能体将研究人员效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially emphasized local compute and shared tools, arguing AI should access user tools for effectiveness, and that shared platforms remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初强调本地算力和共享工具，认为 AI 应访问用户工具以提升效果，且共享平台仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Believed scaffolding would diminish as models improve, focusing on capabilities and safety; also highlighted AI's impact on junior employees.
felixrieseberg.zh: 认为随着模型改进，脚手架将减少，重点转向能力和安全；同时强调 AI 对初级员工的影响。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted to emphasizing AI for tedious background tasks, noting the main gap is people's understanding that any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向强调 AI 处理繁琐后台任务，指出主要差距在于人们理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Advocated for asynchronous AI interaction, judging by final impact, and using Claude to debug workflows rather than correcting mistakes directly.
felixrieseberg.zh: 倡导异步 AI 交互，以最终影响评判，并用 Claude 调试工作流而非直接纠正错误。

felixrieseberg.en: Emphasized kids' natural aptitude with AI and the value of building custom hardware, showing a shift toward practical, creative applications.
felixrieseberg.zh: 强调孩子对 AI 的天生适应力以及构建定制硬件的价值，显示出向实用、创造性应用的转变。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory are key.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列和暂存器内存是关键。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs to US; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济效益来定义，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是采纳成功的关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; GUIs over CLIs; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体辅助而非替代人类，SaaS 仍将增长，图形界面优于命令行，基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments human work, requiring oversight; non-coders benefit greatly; practical value over hype.
danshipper.zh: 始终如一：AI 增强而非取代人类工作，需要人类监督；非程序员受益巨大；重视实际价值而非炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level, not just model-level.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性防止企业垄断，安全是系统级属性而非单一模型属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO/RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法，SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO/RL 补充个性和推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练的关键突破，存在过度优化风险，开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽，增长转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; US-China gap may widen due to compute constraints.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，算力限制可能拉大中美差距。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from mocking up to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从制作模型转向协助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors for AI era.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才而非 T 型人才；AI 时代应招聘有潜力的新毕业生而非资深人士。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient, judgment and vision key.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、潜力新毕业生；仅凭品味不够，判断力和愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; focus on work and users, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；聚焦工作和用户，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed and shipping early become core trust-building; 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument; ambiguity is unique value.
jennywen.zh: 速度和快速交付成为建立信任的核心；“人人都在用”不是设计论据；与模糊共处是独特价值。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处向前试探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于模拟的世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term; infrastructure over algorithms.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超过 Robotaxi；基础设施比算法更重要。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving; synthetic superintelligences likely inert.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）带来涌现能力；视觉足以支撑驾驶；合成超级智能可能是惰性的。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but needs entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; LLMs as OS; decade of agents; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：软件 3.0：提示即程序；LLM 如操作系统；智能体的十年；氛围编程提升入门门槛。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年：LLM 是幽灵而非动物；强化学习糟糕；合成数据坍缩；认知核心极小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate all coding; verifiability determines automation; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：智能体式工程：全部编码委托；可验证性决定自动化；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical; industry is at the very start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺仍然关键；行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；随着基准测试滞后，衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习来实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it preserves value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具，提供可解释性；隐藏它可保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大风险是权力集中。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop freely. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张不应控制 AI，而应让其自由发展；试图通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标，不是真正的学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: RL is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，而当前大语言模型部署后并不从经验中学习。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations, paired with truth detectors, can drive creative discovery.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉，配合真值检测器，可驱动创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to surpass human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model as product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn; chat is MS-DOS, future UI beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，像软件一样迭代，每日发布以学习；聊天是 MS-DOS，未来界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Retention is north star; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements; proactive assistants for next billion users.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：留存是北极星；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进；为下一个十亿用户打造主动式助手。

turley.en: Reasoning models transformative when productized seamlessly; pricing evolves, unlimited plans unsustainable; curiosity key skill.
turley.zh: 2026 年：推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性；定价随技术演变，无限套餐不可持续；好奇心是关键技能。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠大语言模型可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators, not just leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练且有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估，而非仅仅优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; final reward alone is insufficient, as models can reward hack.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务；仅靠最终奖励是不够的，因为模型可能钻奖励的空子。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its unique thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数将分化，导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；医生可能因锚定效应而表现不如单独使用 AI；安全应优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

nando.en: AI should augment humans; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应增强人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: AI 安全是最大的开放挑战；非洲可以跨越遗留问题并做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion as essential for beneficial AI development.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性对于有益 AI 发展至关重要。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism to broader societal and safety concerns, including education and leapfrogging.
nando.zh: 从技术乐观转向更广泛的社会和安全关切，包括教育和跨越式发展。

nando.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 相信根本性创新可以来自任何地方；研究需要拥抱失败。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家级表现并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI；编码是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands capabilities, and progress is accelerating.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）扩展能力，且进展在加速。

sholto.en: AI has capability overhang; managing agent teams and compute supply matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 存在能力过剩；当前管理智能体团队和算力供应比原始智能更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并利用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应优先展示工艺与意图，而非过程文档。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; AI adoption is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能大组；采用 AI 已成为基本要求。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand storytelling attracts talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事成为吸引人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut beats data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审；流程因问题而异；在快速初创中直觉优于数据。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好算法和数据的较小模型可以在特定任务上超越较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment, but RLHF data is proprietary and brute-force.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我坚持认为仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全和对齐至关重要，但 RLHF 数据是专有的且粗暴，需要开放替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; abductive reasoning is key for scientific discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识，而非超越；溯因推理是科学发现的关键，超越归纳和演绎。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive; small models can rival larger ones with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高；同时，利用多样化的合成数据，小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so we must embrace value pluralism in AI systems.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类多样价值观；既然互联网去偏不可能，我们必须在 AI 系统中拥抱价值多元主义。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，认为 AI 市场将转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，创业公司应聚焦应用层 AI。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents often produce incorrect code; fixing is harder than writing; productivity gains require root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，指出编程智能体常生成错误代码，修复比编写更难；生产力提升需进行根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation over human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，认为未来编程语言需优先考虑 AI 生成代码的可验证性，而非人类易用性。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will become as important as websites or mobile apps; outcome-based pricing aligns value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，强调客户体验 AI 智能体将媲美网站或移动应用；基于结果的定价与业务价值对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，预测推理成本大幅下降催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转为操作者。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress, but test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更好；缩放定律预测进展，但推理时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, evolving toward higher-level intent specification with humans in control.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并逐步转向更高层次的意图指定，由人类掌控。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本上；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，需数十年；品味和逻辑设计技能将比细致更宝贵。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; they are contaminated and miss context-dependent messiness.
truell.zh: 始终认为，基准测试无法真实反映编程，易受污染且忽略上下文相关的复杂性。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important, not less.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将成为最大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师的角色从砌砖工变为架构师，编程的重要性不降反升。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers for well-defined tasks, with humans providing oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师处理定义明确的任务，人类负责监督。

scottwu.en: Stickiness, not moats, is key for AI products, built through accumulated knowledge and workflow integration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 产品的关键在于粘性而非护城河，粘性通过知识积累和工作流整合实现。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox; AI will not eliminate engineers but change their role.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：由于杰文斯悖论，软件工程需求将增加；AI 不会消灭工程师，而是改变其角色。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 不是突然发生的，而是渐进过程。产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年的进步。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on alignment and robustness, not just capabilities.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚不充分，应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，而非单纯追求能力。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. Third-party oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不够；需第三方监管，并提高滥用成本以争取时间。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是一个 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展能让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）能实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我指出测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous. Coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 被低估了，其经济影响将远超万亿美元；编码应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。
